---
title: "Tea, Caffeine & Decision Companion"
---

A comprehensive scientific and socio-ritual database organized as a **symmetric 4×4 grid**: four foundational modules, each with four fact-packed branches—tables, parameter definitions, and equations grounded in peer-reviewed biochemistry, clinical pharmacology, behavioral economics, and historical sources. Content on these pages comes only from owner-supplied verified packs.

**Modules**

- [1. The Chemical Core](modules/module-01.qmd) — species genetics, enzymatic oxidation, extraction kinetics, and active compound profiles.
- [2. Synaptic Mechanisms & Physiological Biomarkers](modules/module-02.qmd) — synaptic receptor kinetics, neural wave signatures, endocrinology, and autonomic biomarkers.
- [3. Geopolitics, Ritual & Embodied Cognition](modules/module-03.qmd) — trade and sovereignty history, monastic contexts, thermal priming, and ritual psychology.
- [4. Dual-Process Decision Dynamics](modules/module-04.qmd) — dual-process effort, risk and intertemporal choice, game-theoretic payoffs, and empirical protocols.

**Reference pages**

- [Cup reference](cup-reference.qmd) — standard-cup (250 mL) yield ranges for caffeine, L-theanine, EGCG, and total catechins.
- [Glossary](glossary.qmd) — 29 technical terms mapped to module branches.
- [Linkages](linkages.qmd) — 11 cross-branch scientific linkages with citations.
- [Bibliography](bibliography.qmd) — primary citations from the master database, additions packs, and bibliographic audit.
